title: Twitter Competitor Users
description: Search public Twitter/X user profiles by competitor brand name or industry keyword and save the matching accounts as leads. Best for identifying companies, thought leaders, or professionals whose public profile matches a reviewed market term.
tips:
- "searchTerms" must contain the exact competitor brand names or industry keywords you want to search.
- Keep maxItems aligned with the reviewed global saved-lead cap for small, auditable runs.
- This workflow finds matching public profiles; it does not find a competitor's followers.
- Use precise terms to reduce unrelated profile matches.
- Keyword search matches public profile names/bios. Use short brand or industry terms, not a sentence combining every role and location. It does not provide a geographic search filter. Enforce the reviewed geography on actual profile location evidence.
- The provider fetch budget is at least 5 candidates; the reviewed final saved-lead cap remains separate. Do not automatically broaden a no-result search or start another paid run.
